items.title: Rev 4 · The Token HUD sits under every window; its Lingering click still adds or ends one
items.do: Select Kaela (or the Orc Warrior) and open her character sheet. Right-click her token so Foundry's Token HUD shows (combat toggle, the status palette, the Vigor / Resolve boxes), then drag the sheet over the HUD. Open the status palette and click Lingering: give 1d6 Fi in the window that opens; click Lingering again and choose "Add another Lingering", then once more and choose "End" on one.
items.expect: The sheet covers the Token HUD where they overlap (the HUD is under it, not drawn through it); the Lingering damage window opens above the Token HUD, and any other window (the sheet, a pick window) is above it too. The Token HUD's Vigor / Resolve boxes and its status palette are still above the system's HUD bar at the bottom. With a Lingering already on, the click asks in the bottom bar "Add another Lingering", one "End Lingering ..." for each, and Cancel; "End" removes only that one.

items.title: Rev 2 · Charge stops at the weapon's normal Range
items.do: Durgan (Arming Sword) Charges an Orc Warrior 5 squares away. Then Sylwen, with her Hunting Bow in hand, Charges an orc about 14 squares away; then with only her Dagger in hand.
items.expect: Durgan stops adjacent, as before (the orc at 5 squares is not "too close"). Sylwen with the bow stops on the first square from which the orc is within 8 squares (the Hunting Bow's normal Range, 8/16/24), the line and texts saying "in Range"; an orc already within 10 is "too close" (fewer than 3 squares to run). With the Dagger the bottom bar first asks "Dagger (in hand) (Range 1)" or "Dagger (thrown) (Range 4)", and she stops where that Range reaches.
